description: A multithreading engine for The Lost Cities project. Offloads all heavy calculations to a dedicated thread manager via the Quantified API, delivering an extreme performance boost.

mods.name: LC2H [Lost Cities: Multithreaded]
mods.description: LC2H [Lost Cities: Multithreaded] is an addon for Lost Cities that uses Quantified API scheduling, exact Vulkan city-center compute with CPU fallback, optional experimental Vulkan/OpenCL region-prefilter support, and an asynchronous processing system to deliver significant performance improvements. It also includes extensive bug fixes for Lost Cities and general gameplay issues, along with a wide range of optimizations and QoL enhancements that make the game smoother, more stable, and overall much better to play.

releases.notes:
## LC2H V4.2.0-LTS :]

Finally added the NeoForge port and fixed a ton of the remaining V4 worldgen issues.

### Main stuff

- One jar now supports Forge 1.20.1 and NeoForge 1.21.1.
- Shared code was moved out of the Forge-only folder so both loaders use the same blender, planners, cleanup, tree, and kernel systems.
- The city blender was reworked properly. It now follows Minecraft's own NoiseChunk/noise path, so mountains and hills keep their normal vanilla look instead of getting chopped into flat walls.
- City edges now blend over a wider area with better slope handling, edge recovery, and fewer random chunks being skipped.
- Fixed a bunch of terrain seams, mountain cutoffs, missing city-edge chunks, and concurrent versus serial generation mismatches.

### Trees and buildings

- Fixed large trees being cut at chunk borders.
- Fixed trees losing their middle while the leaves and branches stayed behind.
- Deferred trees now keep all touched chunks loaded, wait for the area to settle, and replay their blocks in safe batches.
- Fixed multi-chunk buildings being treated differently depending on which chunk finished first.
- Fixed deferred Lost Cities loot handling touching the live world during generation, which could trigger FastChunkGen/C2ME retries.

### Vine and vegetation cleanup

- Fixed cleanup missing normal vines, glow lichen, and Immersive Weathering frost.
- Added support for hanging roots, chains, modded vine-like blocks, and extra IDs from the config.
- Registry loading order no longer makes frost or lichen disappear from the cleaner.
- Large connected clusters are scanned asynchronously instead of freezing the generation worker.
- Full scans use bounded queues, retries, overflow handling, palette skipping, and adaptive budgets so cleanup does not randomly stop when the world is busy.
- Actual block changes are still applied safely on the server thread.

### Compatibility and performance

- Improved C2ME and FastChunkGen compatibility.
- Generation workers no longer wait on unfinished planner, cache, height, or blender work.
- QAPI scheduling, CPU kernels, GPU paths, and safe fallbacks all remain available.
- Added more diagnostics for queues, locks, planners, trees, cleanup, caches, and terrain blending.

### Config and debugging

- Fixed the Forge and NeoForge config UI blur, scaling, oversized header, scrollbar overlap, and button layout.
- Added the LC2H logging toggle, disabled by default.
- Expanded `/lc2h diagnostics`, `/lc2h whyflat`, blender commands, tree diagnostics, cleanup stats, and chunkdebug exports.
- Changing blender settings only affects newly generated chunks. Existing chunks are not regenerated automatically.

Still compatible with the current Lost Cities 7.5.4 setup :]
